types.name: Deck
docs: The shuffled deck. **Delegated to the ER; made TEE-private in Phase 4.**
Until Phase 4 this account is world-readable, which is exactly why Phase 3
plays face-up: the privacy work is what makes hidden cards possible, and
pretending otherwise before then would be dishonest.

fields.name: vrf_randomness
docs: Raw VRF output, delivered here rather than to the public hand.
The deck account is the one place nobody can read, and the seed must be
secret while the hand runs: salts are public once revealed, so seed and
VRF output on a readable account would let anyone recompute the entire
deck mid-hand. Both are copied to the hand at settlement, which is when
the verifier needs them and the moment they stop being dangerous.

fields.name: shuffle_seed
docs: `vrf_randomness XOR salt_xor`, fixed when the hand starts.

fields.name: shuffle_state
docs: The private half of the shuffle state machine. The public half on the
hand only ever says "requested", because fulfillment arriving is itself
information about when the deck became computable inside the enclave.

types.name: Hand
docs: The hand in progress. **Delegated to the ER.**
One PDA per table, overwritten each hand rather than created per hand, so no
new account has to be delegated between hands.

fields.name: street
docs: Encodes [`poker_engine::betting::Street`].

fields.name: board
docs: Community cards; `0xFF` for undealt slots.

fields.name: current_bet
docs: Highest street commitment anyone must match.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: Minimum raise increment over `current_bet`.

fields.name: to_act
docs: Seat to act, or [`NO_SEAT`] when the street is complete.

fields.name: dealt_in
docs: Bitmask of seats dealt into this hand. Lets instructions that only touch
hole cards avoid loading all six seat accounts, which keeps them inside
the BPF stack frame.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix time after which anyone may force a timeout on `to_act`.

fields.name: shuffle_seed
docs: Seed the deck was shuffled from, published at hand end so the shuffle can
be verified. Phase 5 fills this from VRF combined with player salts.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Hole cards of players who reached showdown, copied here at settlement so
they become public. Everyone else is mucked and stays `0xFF`.

fields.name: revealed_mask
docs: Bitmask of seats whose cards were revealed rather than mucked.

fields.name: salt_xor
docs: XOR of every revealed salt, accumulated as players reveal.

fields.name: salt_mask
docs: Bitmask of seats that have revealed a salt this hand.

fields.name: vrf_randomness
docs: Raw VRF output, kept alongside the salts so the combination is checkable.

fields.name: shuffle_state
docs: 0 idle, 1 requested, 2 fulfilled.

fields.name: result_hash
docs: Digest of the finished hand: number, seed, board and payouts. Committed to
the base layer so a hand can be pinned without publishing every detail.

types.name: HoleCards
docs: Hole cards for one seat. **Delegated to the ER; TEE-private from Phase 4.**
Phase 3 keeps these public so the real-time loop can be built and verified
first. Phase 4 attaches an `EphemeralPermission` whose only member is the
seat's occupant.

types.name: Player
docs: A player's chip balance and faucet state. **Never delegated.**
This is the only account that holds chips at rest, and it stays on the base
layer so a player's balance is always settled on Solana rather than living
inside a rollup. Chips are play money: they enter only through the faucet and
can never leave for anything of value.

fields.name: chips
docs: Chips not currently committed to a seat.

types.name: PlayerMove
docs: A betting action, in the shape the client sends it.

types.name: Seat
docs: One seat's chips and per-hand state. **Delegated to the ER.**
One PDA per seat index, created with the table and reused for its lifetime, so
a seat's address is stable and never needs re-delegating as players come and go.

fields.name: occupant
docs: Current occupant, or `Pubkey::default()` when empty.

fields.name: stack
docs: Chips in front of this seat. Moves to and from [`Player::chips`].

fields.name: committed_street
docs: Chips pushed forward on the current street.

fields.name: committed_total
docs: Chips pushed forward across the whole hand.

fields.name: needs_action
docs: Still owes an action this street.

fields.name: may_raise
docs: May raise if it acts. Cleared by an under-raise all-in, per poker rules.

fields.name: in_hand
docs: Dealt in for the current hand. False for someone who joined mid-hand.

fields.name: salt_commit
docs: SHA-256 of this seat's shuffle salt, submitted before the deal.

fields.name: salt
docs: The revealed salt. Published so anyone can recompute the shuffle.

fields.name: salt_state
docs: 0 none, 1 committed, 2 revealed.

types.name: Table
docs: Mutable table state. **Delegated to the ER.**

fields.name: seats
docs: Occupant of each seat, or `Pubkey::default()` when empty.

fields.name: empty_since
docs: When the last player left, or 0 while anyone is still seated.
Appended after `bump` on purpose: every field before it keeps the
offset it has always had, so a client reading a table written by an
older build gets the same answers and simply finds nothing here.
An abandoned table would otherwise sit in the lobby forever, because
only its creator can delete it and creators lose keys. This is the
clock that lets anyone sweep one once it has been empty long enough.

types.name: TableConfig
docs: Immutable table parameters. **Never delegated.**

fields.name: action_timeout_secs
docs: Seconds a player has to act before anyone may time them out. Per table so
a fast game and a slow game can coexist.

types.name: TableHistory
docs: Base-layer record of hands played at a table. **Never delegated.**
Written by a post-commit Magic Action at settlement, so the rollup can leave a
permanent trace on Solana without anyone sending a separate transaction.
